description: This file contains R source code defining classes, methods, and functions for various MLlib classification algorithms in Spark, including SVM, Logistic Regression, Multilayer Perceptron, Naive Bayes, and Factorization Machines. It provides model fitting, prediction, summary, and save/load functionalities.

classes.name: LinearSVCModel
classes.description: Represents a trained linear SVM model in Spark.

classes.name: LogisticRegressionModel
classes.description: Represents a trained logistic regression model in Spark.

classes.name: MultilayerPerceptronClassificationModel
classes.description: Represents a trained multilayer perceptron classifier in Spark.

classes.name: NaiveBayesModel
classes.description: Represents a trained Naive Bayes model in Spark.

classes.name: FMClassificationModel
classes.description: Represents a trained Factorization Machines classifier in Spark.

methods.name: spark.svmLinear
methods.description: Fits a linear SVM model to SparkDataFrame with specified formula and parameters.

methods.name: spark.logit
methods.description: Fits a logistic regression model to SparkDataFrame with specified formula and parameters.

methods.name: spark.mlp
methods.description: Fits a Multilayer Perceptron classifier to SparkDataFrame with specified formula and parameters.

methods.name: spark.naiveBayes
methods.description: Fits a Naive Bayes model to SparkDataFrame with specified formula and parameters.

methods.name: spark.fmClassifier
methods.description: Fits a Factorization Machines classifier to SparkDataFrame with specified formula and parameters.
